title: Effects of physical exercise in sarcopenia on patients undergoing bariatric surgery: A protocol for a randomized clinical trial
author: Santos, Cinza, et al.

steps.title: Patient Enrollment
steps.instruction: Recruit patients and obtain signed informed consent forms from all participants.

steps.title: Anthropometric Measurements
steps.instruction: Collect baseline physical measurements to calculate body mass index and abdominal circumference.

substeps.instruction: Measure abdominal circumference using a measuring tape

steps.title: Metabolic and Clinical Analysis
steps.instruction: Perform clinical and hormonal evaluations to determine metabolic risk factors.

substeps.instruction: Collect blood samples during routine surgical evaluation to determine inflammatory markers and hormonal profile (including leptin and ghrelin concentrations)
Evaluate mean blood pressure using a digital sphygmomanometer

steps.title: Saliva Collection
steps.instruction: Collect saliva samples for analysis by the biochemistry department.

substeps.instruction: Collect saliva into a small recipient for five minutes at the moments of evaluation

steps.title: Glycemia Monitoring
steps.instruction: Monitor glycemia variation using an implantable device.

substeps.instruction: Use an implantable 24-hour monitoring device for 5 days

steps.title: Body Composition Analysis
steps.instruction: Measure body composition using Dual-energy X-ray absorptiometry (DEXA, Hologic QDR, Hologic, Inc., Bedford, MA, USA).

steps.title: Muscle Strength and Fatigue Evaluation
steps.instruction: Assess upper and lower limb strength and fatigue using dynamometry and functional tests.

substeps.instruction: Evaluate upper limb strength via manual pressure dynamometry (Handgrip) in both hands with a maximum contraction of five seconds
Evaluate lower limb strength via the sit to stand test (maximum repetitions of standing and sitting for 30 seconds)

Evaluate lower limb strength and muscle fatigue using an isokinetic dynamometer (Biodex®, System 3 Pro, Biodex Corp., Shirley, NY, USA) with two series: 6 repetitions at 60°/sec and 25 repetitions at 180°/sec

steps.title: Cardiorespiratory Fitness Assessment
steps.instruction: Assess cardiorespiratory fitness using the 6-minute walk test (TC6).

steps.title: Physical Activity Monitoring
steps.instruction: Measure sedentary behavior and physical activity using accelerometers (ActiGraph GT3X model, Fort Walton Beach, Florida, USA).

substeps.instruction: Apply accelerometers for 5 days before surgery
Apply accelerometers three times after the exercise program

steps.title: Quality of Life Assessment
steps.instruction: Administer the Bariatric Analysis and Reporting Outcome System (BAROS) questionnaire (Portuguese validated version) as a life quality self-report measure.
